title: Height / counts
when: Return height, total nodes and leaves using recursive subtree results.
parts: nodes
Add 1 for this node plus the counts in both subtrees.
leaves
Count 1 only when both child pointers are null.
heightOf
Use 1 + maximum child height. Empty -1 makes a leaf height 0.
change: Change the values in main(). Keep the null checks and reconnect returned subtree roots. Use the template example if the stored type must change.
watch: Root depth is 0, but root height is the longest path down. All three functions take O(n).

title: Clear / reuse
when: Delete every node safely, then reuse the empty tree.
parts: destroy
Postorder deletion keeps each parent alive until its child links have been used.
clear / destructor
clear resets root; the destructor calls clear automatically.
Copying
Disabled because a shallow copy would make two trees own the same nodes.
change: Change the values in main(). Keep the null checks and reconnect returned subtree roots. Use the template example if the stored type must change.
watch: This removes ALL nodes, not one chosen BST value. Never access node after delete.
